desc: Outcome of 15th Annual General Meeting of EKI Energy Services Limited

The company has fixed Regulation 60(2) Record Date Interest Payment / Redemption / Dividend for the purpose of
Intimation of Notice of the 17th Annual General Meeting of IOT Utkal Energy Services Limited for the Financial Year ended on 31st March 2026 under Regulation 50(2) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015.
Submission of Annual Report for the Financial Year ended 31st March 2026 under Regulation 53 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015
Intimation of Notice of the 17th AGM and Annual Report for the Financial Year ended 31st March 2026 under Regulation 56 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015.
Intimation regarding the order passed by the Hon''ble National Company Law Tribunal, Indore Bench, in relation to Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP)
